credanta.tagline: Keep every certificate in view, from issue to renewal.
credanta.description: Credanta is envisioned as a certificate lifecycle workspace for teams managing the digital trust behind their services. It brings certificate ownership, validity and renewal planning into a clearer operational view, helping teams move from scattered records to a coordinated lifecycle.
credanta.problemSolved: Certificate records can be spread across services, systems and teams. When ownership and expiry dates are difficult to trace, renewal planning becomes reactive and the continuity of important services is harder to manage.
features: A central inventory for certificate records and accountable owners
Visibility into validity periods and upcoming renewals
Coordinated issue, renewal and retirement workflows
differentiators: Lifecycle context that connects certificate records to service responsibility
benefits: A clearer view of certificate responsibility
More deliberate renewal planning across teams
credanta.deploymentModel: The deployment approach, integrations and supported certificate types will be defined during product discovery.
credanta.status: Product concept — scope and availability to be confirmed with the Vyntiq team.

crucible.tagline: Bring evidence, context and the next question together.
crucible.description: Crucible is envisioned as a focused investigation workspace for teams working through complex evidence. It brings case material, timelines and findings into a shared context, helping investigators follow a question through to a reasoned conclusion without losing the trail behind it.
crucible.problemSolved: Investigation material often sits across documents, notes and separate systems. As a case develops, it becomes harder to connect events, track open questions and explain how a finding was reached.
features: Structured case workspaces for documents, notes and findings
Chronological views of events and investigation milestones
Connections between evidence, questions and working conclusions
Review and handover workflows that preserve case context
differentiators: A case-centered experience designed around the reasoning trail
Context that stays alongside findings as investigations develop
targetCustomers: Enterprise security and internal review teams
benefits: Clearer communication of findings and unresolved questions
crucible.deploymentModel: Deployment, evidence integrations and access requirements will be scoped with the organization during product discovery.
crucible.status: Product concept — scope and availability to be confirmed with the Vyntiq team.

mukeradb.tagline: A dependable foundation for connected, useful data.
mukeradb.description: MukeraDB is envisioned as a data foundation for organizations turning fragmented information into a dependable resource. Its proposed direction brings structure, relationships and ownership into focus, giving applications and operational teams a clearer basis for finding and using the information they need.
mukeradb.problemSolved: Data spread across disconnected sources is difficult to discover, understand and maintain. Teams need a clearer view of how information is organized, who is responsible for it and where it fits in their workflows.
features: Discoverable records and meaningful data relationships
Integration pathways for applications and analytical workflows
differentiators: A product direction centered on useful data context and organizational control
useCases: Preparing information for analysis and intelligent workflows
benefits: More coherent information across teams and systems
A clearer starting point for applications and analysis
mukeradb.deploymentModel: Architecture, supported workloads, integrations and deployment options will be confirmed through technical discovery.
mukeradb.status: Product concept — scope and availability to be confirmed with the Vyntiq team.
